title: Monitoring
description: Monitor PostgreSQL with pg_stat_statements, pg_stat_activity, and metrics.

data.text: Use built-in views and extensions to monitor database health and query performance.

data.title: Stats
data.code:
SELECT query, calls, total_exec_time, mean_exec_time
FROM pg_stat_statements
ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC
LIMIT 10;

data.title: Activity
data.code:
SELECT pid, usename, state, query_start, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state <> 'idle'
ORDER BY query_start;

data.title: Tip
data.text: Use pg_stat_statements for query regression detection.
